$comment: PROTECTED FIXTURE SET (plan §14). Repair agents have no write access to this file. It is loaded read-only by the verifier and executed again by CI outside the proposer's permissions (plan §11, §15). Expected outcomes were decided BEFORE any candidate was generated; editing them to make a candidate pass is the exact failure this file exists to prevent.
